name: FuriosaAI RNGD (Renegade) - eval-only, no retail channel
price_basis: No retail price exists: RNGD is request-access / eval only via furiosa.ai/signup - bare-metal or API-endpoint eval for enterprise. price_usd null = gated.
lead_time_basis: lead_time_weeks is null because hardware is granted on eval request, not sold on a schedule.
notes: RNGD is the real LLM part (furiosa-llm serves OpenAI-compatible inference, 180W PCIe) but hardware is unobtainium for a hobbyist. NOTE: accelerator_ids points at furiosaai-warboy, the only Furiosa record in the repo - RNGD itself has no accelerator record yet; the gen-1 Warboy card that surfaces used is a 64-TOPS vision NPU, paperweight for LLMs.
